Last resort in Product Quality only when no specific theme fits. Prefer first: viscosity thick/thin, Smell/Odor, Poor Coverage, Product Separation, Bubble forming, Slow Initial Tack / Grab, Long Pressing / Clamping Time, Weak Ultimate Bond / Delamination, Overall Good product (general praise / no issues), Good grab (positive grab/tack), Helping/ Enabling me to complete sites faster. Do not use for general product praise or good-grab praise.

Last resort in Product Packaging only when no specific theme fits. Prefer first: Lid / Cap Hard to Open, Packaging Failure / Transit Leakage, Nozzle Clogging / Hardening, Re-sealing Issue / Product Drying in Tub, Application difficulty, Good packaging (packaging praise / sturdy pack / no spoilage). Do not use for packaging praise — use Good packaging. Pack shape/size change requests belong under New Packaging Idea when that is the ask.

Last resort in Post application feedback only when no specific theme fits. Prefer first: Joint Separation, Glue Line Hardening (Damages Tools), Staining & Discoloration, Breakage due to expansion, Nail destroys aesthetics, Easy to use (easy to pour/apply/handle). Do not use for ease-of-use praise — use Easy to use.

Last resort in Applicator & Spreader Tools only when no specific theme fits. Prefer first: Spreader Missing, Spreader Flimsy / Poor Quality, Wrong Spreader Size, Request for Specific Tool, Insufficient Quantity of Applicators, New Application for existing product.
Last resort in New Product Idea only when the feedback is product-idea related but does not fit the New Product Idea theme itself. Prefer New Product Idea for concrete new-SKU / new-variant requests.

Last resort in New Packaging Idea only when packaging-idea related feedback does not fit New Packaging Idea. Prefer New Packaging Idea for pack shape/size/format change requests. Packaging praise goes to Good packaging, not here.
Last resort in New Substrate only when substrate-related feedback does not fit New Substrate. Prefer New Substrate for new boards/materials/surfaces the user wants supported.

Last resort in Product & its Application Knowledge gap only when knowledge-gap feedback does not fit that theme. Prefer Product & its Application Knowledge gap when the user lacks how-to / application know-how.
Last resort in FCC App Usability & Tech only when no specific theme fits. Prefer first: Scan / OCR Failure, Login / OTP Issue, Interface Freezing / Lag / Crashing, Point/Activity Sync Issues.
Last resort in Mpower only when the feedback is Mpower-related but does not fit Recording related issue. Prefer Recording related issue for recording failures/problems.
Last resort in Jharokha only when Jharokha-related feedback does not fit Awareness videos. Prefer Awareness videos for video content / awareness asks.

Last resort in Competitor Product only when no specific theme fits. Prefer first: Better product (competitor product seen as better), New product (competitor launched / offering a new product). Pidilite product praise is not this category.
Last resort in Competitor Pricing only when no specific theme fits. Prefer first: Better scheme & Better coupons, MOP - Market operating price.
Last resort in Competitor Field execution only when no specific theme fits. Prefer first: Continuous trial to switch, Product cataloging.
Last resort in Competitor Engagement only when no specific theme fits. Prefer first: Competition Engagement, Competition Manpower/ Infra related.
Last resort in dealer stock only when no specific theme fits. Prefer Product Out of Stock for availability / OOS complaints.
Last resort in Influence & Relationships only when no specific theme fits. Prefer Pushing Competitor Brands (Brand Switching) when the dealer pushes competitors.
Last resort in Support only when no specific theme fits. Prefer first: No/ sporadic Field Rep Visit, Slow Complaint Resolution.

Last resort in FCC Meet/ Other meets only when no specific theme fits. Prefer first: Infrequent Meets / Low Engagement, Request for Demo / Training, Request for Recognition / Awards, Issues with Meet Logistics & Invites, Marketing material of portfolio - stimulus, Competition meet up and group activity overshadowing us.

Last resort in Schemes only when no specific theme fits. Prefer first: User Trips, Scheme - equivalence, Cash benefits, Unrealistic Slabs & Targets, Delayed Payouts / Gift Settlement, Physical Token Missing from Pack, Physical Token Damaged / Unreadable.

Last resort in Points & Redemption only when no specific theme fits. Prefer first: Issues with Insurance & Benefits, Point Expiry Dispute, Long Delivery Timelines for Gifts, Poor Quality / No Warranty on Gifts, Limited Gift Catalog / New Gift Request, Lack of Access to Redemption Center.
User praises the product overall: good quality, no issues, satisfied, best glue/product. Use instead of Product Quality Others for general praise.
User praises initial grab/tack/grip (holds quickly, good grab). Not for weak grab complaints.

taxonomy.feedback_tag: Helping/ Enabling me to complete sites faster
taxonomy.description: User says the product helps finish sites/jobs faster or improves on-site speed/productivity.
User praises packaging: packaging is good, sturdy, no damage/spoilage, reseals well, liked the pack. Use instead of Product Packaging Others for packaging praise.
User says the product is easy to pour, apply, handle, or use. Use instead of Post application Others for ease-of-use praise.
